Rashi on Berakhot 8a:12:1.hebrew: לעת מצא זו מיתה - שימות במיתה יפה ונחה:
Rashi on Berakhot 8a:12:1.english: "At a time of finding," this is death - That he should die a good and peaceful death.

Rashi on Berakhot 8a:13:1.english: Askara [croup] - Estranglement [strangulation] in the vernacular [Old French], which is inside the body.

Rashi on Berakhot 8a:13:2.hebrew: כחיזרא בגבבא דעמרא דלאחורי נשרא - כענפי הסירים הנסבכים בגזת הצמר, כשאדם נותק בחזקה ומשליך לאחור, שאי אפשר שלא ינתק הצמר עמה:
Rashi on Berakhot 8a:13:2.english: Like a thorn branch in a bundle of wool that is pulled backward - Like the branches of thornbushes entangled in a fleece of wool, when a person tears [them] out forcefully and casts [them] backward, as it is impossible for the wool not to be torn out with them.

Rashi on Berakhot 8a:13:3.hebrew: כפיטורי בפי ושט - ים אוקיינוס יש בו מקומות שאינו מקבל ברזל, ומחברין לוחי הספינה ע"י חבלים ועקלים שתוחבי' בנקביו, ותוקעין אותו בדוחק, לפי שהם גסין כמדת הנקב:
Rashi on Berakhot 8a:13:3.english: Like ropes in the opening of the esophagus - In the ocean, there are places that do not accept iron, and they join the planks of the ship by means of ropes and cables that they thrust into its holes, and drive them in with difficulty, because they are thick, matching the size of the hole.

Rashi on Berakhot 8a:13:4.hebrew: פיטורי - חבלים, דמתרגמינן ופטורי ציצים (מלכים א ו׳:י״ח) אטונין:
Rashi on Berakhot 8a:13:4.english: Ropes - [Means] ropes, as we translate "and open flowers" (I Kings 6:18) [in the Targum as] "cords."

Rashi on Berakhot 8a:1:1.hebrew: עת רצון - אלמא יש שעה שהיא של רצון:
Rashi on Berakhot 8a:1:1.english: A time of favor - Evidently, there is a time that is of favor.

Rashi on Berakhot 8a:3:1.hebrew: כביר לא ימאס - תפלת הרבים לא ימאס:
Rashi on Berakhot 8a:3:1.english: Mighty, He will not despise - He will not despise the prayer of the multitude.

Rashi on Berakhot 8a:3:2.english: From the battle against me - From the battles that come upon me.

Rashi on Berakhot 8a:3:3.hebrew: כי ברבים היו עמדי - שהתפללו עמי:
Rashi on Berakhot 8a:3:3.english: For there were many with me - That they prayed with me.

Rashi on Berakhot 8a:4:1.hebrew: פדה בשלום - זה שעסק בדברי שלום, דהיינו תורה, דכתיב: וכל נתיבותיה שלום (משלי ג׳:י״ז). וכן גמילות חסדים נמי שלום הוא, שמתוך שגומל חסד בגופו לחבירו, הוא מכיר שהוא אוהבו, ובא לידי אחוה ושלום:
Rashi on Berakhot 8a:4:1.english: He has redeemed in peace - This refers to one who engaged in matters of peace, namely Torah, as it is written: "And all her paths are peace" (Proverbs 3:17). And so too, acts of kindness are also peace, for since he performs an act of kindness with his person for his fellow, [his fellow] recognizes that he loves him, and [this] leads to brotherhood and peace.

Rashi on Berakhot 8a:5:1.hebrew: הנני נותשם מעל אדמתם - סיפיה דקרא הוא:
Rashi on Berakhot 8a:5:1.english: Behold, I will pluck them up from off their land - This is the end of the [same] verse.

Rashi on Berakhot 8a:6:1.english: They go early - In the morning.

Rashi on Berakhot 8a:6:2.hebrew: מחשכי - ערבית, כלומר מאריכין בבית הכנסת:
Rashi on Berakhot 8a:6:2.english: Stay late - In the evening; that is, they prolong [their stay] in the synagogue.

Rashi on Berakhot 8a:8:1.hebrew: שיעור של שני פתחים - רוחב יכנס לפנים, שלא ישב סמוך לפתח, דנראה עליו כמשוי עכוב בית הכנסת, ויהא מזומן סמוך לפתח לצאת:
Rashi on Berakhot 8a:8:1.english: A distance of two doorways - [A distance of their] width he should enter inside, so that he does not sit near the doorway, for remaining in the synagogue would appear like a burden upon him, and he would be ready near the doorway to leave.

Rashi on Berakhot 8a:9:1.hebrew: יתפלל לעת מצא - יתפלל שיהו מצויין לו כשיצטרך:
Rashi on Berakhot 8a:9:1.english: Let him pray in the time of finding - He should pray that they will be available to him when he needs them.
